user.title: Energy Sharing setup
user.description: Configure solar energy sharing settlement on the receiving household Home Assistant instance. Select the provider export interval source, receiver grid import interval source, allocation percentage mode, and optionally a reported allocated energy source for reconciliation.

data_description.provider_export_source: Utility Meter or compatible entity exposing the provider household full grid export for the last completed interval (last_period, last_reset).
data_description.receiver_import_source: Utility Meter or compatible entity exposing the receiving household grid import for the last completed interval.
data_description.reported_allocation_source: Optional Utility Meter reporting the provider-side allocated energy for reconciliation only.
data_description.allocation_percentage_source: Entity providing the allocation percentage, such as an input_number, sensor, or number entity.
data_description.fixed_allocation_percentage: Fixed allocation percentage stored in integration options.

error.duplicate_sources: Each selected source entity must be unique.
error.source_missing: The selected entity does not exist.
error.last_period_missing: The selected entity does not expose last_period.
error.last_reset_missing: The selected entity does not expose a valid last_reset timestamp.
error.invalid_interval_value: The selected entity last_period is missing or invalid.
error.unsupported_energy_unit: The selected entity uses an unsupported energy unit. Use Wh or kWh.
error.percentage_invalid: The allocation percentage entity is unavailable or invalid.

abort.already_configured: This provider export and receiver import pair is already configured.

init.title: Energy Sharing options
init.description: Immutable sources: provider export `{provider_export_source}`, receiver import `{receiver_import_source}`. Update allocation percentage, reconciliation, and timing settings here.

error.percentage_invalid: The allocation percentage must be greater than zero.

options.reconciliation_mode_warn: Warn and process with calculated values

process_now.name: Process now
process_now.description: Attempt to process the latest completed interval for the selected Energy Sharing device.

reset_totals.name: Reset totals
reset_totals.description: Reset all cumulative energy totals and interval counters. Source Utility Meters are not changed.

confirm.name: Confirm reset
confirm.description: Must be set to true to confirm resetting cumulative totals.
